title: Jailbreak x Monitor Evasion: Do Successful Jailbreaks Also Suppress Monitorable Cues?

original_idea.body: Run known jailbreak templates against an open model with a downstream CoT monitor and compute the conditional detection rate (monitor catch given jailbreak success).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests whether jailbreaks correlate with monitor evasion, breaking layered-defense independence.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Run public jailbreak templates plus downstream CoT monitor, compute conditional detection.

novelty.reasoning: Jailbreaks and CoT monitoring studied; the joint suppression correlation may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Each studied; the jailbreak-implies-monitor-evasion correlation may be open.
